info.desc: Kick is the sixth studio album by Australian rock band INXS, released on 19 October 1987. The album was produced by British producer Chris Thomas, recorded by David Nicholas in Sydney and Paris and mixed by Bob Clearmountain at AIR Studios in London. After the success of their fifth studio album, Listen Like Thieves (1985), and its second single "What You Need" (1986), INXS knew their new material would have to be even better, according to guitarist Kirk Pengilly, "We wanted an album where all the songs were possible singles". They recorded Kick in Sydney and Paris, it was produced .

podcast.body: Released on October 12, 1987, this album was a monumental international success, reaching #1 in Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, #3 in the US and France, and a top 10 record in the UK. It sold an estimated "north of 20 million" copies, including a million in Canada (twice its sales in Australia). Five of its twelve songs became major singles. "Number one album in Australia, in Canada, and New Zealand. Number three in the US and France. And finally, a top 10 record in the UK. The best estimate of total sales is somewhere north of 20 million."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album from 1987 racked up four more top ten hits for INXS—"Need You Tonight," "Devil Inside," "New Sensation," and "Never Tear Us Apart"—confirming their imperial status after their first American top ten hit the previous year. "when in excess came back in 1987 with their album Kick, which racked up four more top tens."
